newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Deng's death not seen hitting markets - HK's Tsang.
newsitem.headline: Deng's death not seen hitting markets - HK's Tsang.

text.p: Hong Kong's Financial Secretary Donald Tsang said on Thursday the markets were prepared for the death of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping and his passing would have relatively little impact.
"The Hong Kong markets and the Chinese markets have prepared for this moment. I do not think there would be very major volatility," Tsang told reporters.
"Hong Kong is a very strong financial centre... any slight impact would surely pass quickly."
"Deng Xiaoping contributed very much to China's economic opening up...and I feel great sorrow like all Hong Kong people," Tsang said.
The British colony of Hong Kong reverts to Chinese rule in mid-1997.
